Name: NPC Puppycat
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Once upon a time, there was a Space Outlaw...

Puppycat has come to Stardew Valley! He's smart, sassy, and oh so cute (but don't call him cute!)

This NPC is currently pretty barebones because there are plans to move him to an upcoming expansion (shh!) BUT he has full dialogue, gift tastes, and a schedule. He wanders around the valley judging everyone and everything, tormenting Pierre, and generally just being loveable!

Sprites are courtesy of bobacup's original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24187]Puppycat for Cats[/url] mod which they generously gave me permission to use, while portraits are by me (please don't judge me, I'm just a potato)

This is my first custom NPC so please bear with me as he develops 🙏

SMAPI, Content Patcher, and PoohCore are required for this mod, as the sprites are larger than usual NPCs.

Enjoy!
